Summary: God's command to Daniel at the end of his visions: shut up the words and seal the book to the time of the end.
Commandment: Shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end.
Application: A closing command to the aged prophet: seal the book until the time of the end (Daniel 12:4, repeated in 12:9). Its time limit is part of the command itself — sealed, not suppressed forever, with knowledge to increase at the end.
Purpose: To preserve Daniel's vision sealed for the time of the end, when many shall run to and fro and knowledge shall be increased (Daniel 12:4).
